result.instructions: Tools for ClickUp, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ClickUp data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run clickup_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run clickup_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run clickup_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. clickup_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: clickup_get_authorized_user
tools.title: Get authorized user
tools.description: Get the user associated with the current ClickUp API token. ClickUp REST: GET /user.

tools.name: clickup_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces (the ClickUp API calls these "teams") the token can access — their ids are the team_id used by other tools. ClickUp REST: GET /team.

tools.name: clickup_list_spaces
tools.title: List spaces
tools.description: List spaces in a workspace (team). ClickUp REST: GET /team/{team_id}/space.

archived.description: Include archived items — serialized as archived=true/false. Default false.

tools.name: clickup_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List folders in a space. ClickUp REST: GET /space/{space_id}/folder.

archived.description: Include archived items — serialized as archived=true/false. Default false.

tools.name: clickup_list_lists
tools.title: List lists
tools.description: List the lists inside a folder. ClickUp REST: GET /folder/{folder_id}/list.

archived.description: Include archived items — serialized as archived=true/false. Default false.

tools.name: clickup_list_folderless_lists
tools.title: List folderless lists
tools.description: List the lists that live directly in a space (not inside a folder). ClickUp REST: GET /space/{space_id}/list.

archived.description: Include archived items — serialized as archived=true/false. Default false.

tools.name: clickup_get_tasks
tools.title: Get tasks
tools.description: Get the tasks in a list, with optional filters and pagination. ClickUp REST: GET /list/{list_id}/task.

archived.description: Include archived items — serialized as archived=true/false. Default false.

statuses.description: Filter by status names (repeated statuses[] params), e.g. ["open","in progress"].

assignees.description: Filter by assignee user ids (repeated assignees[] params).

due_date_gt.description: Only tasks due after this Unix time in ms.

due_date_lt.description: Only tasks due before this Unix time in ms.

tools.name: clickup_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: Get a single task by id. ClickUp REST: GET /task/{task_id}.

tools.name: clickup_get_task_comments
tools.title: Get task comments
tools.description: Get the comments on a task. ClickUp REST: GET /task/{task_id}/comment.

tools.name: clickup_get_list_comments
tools.title: Get list comments
tools.description: Get the comments on a list. ClickUp REST: GET /list/{list_id}/comment.

tools.name: clickup_search_tasks
tools.title: Search tasks
tools.description: Search/filter tasks across a whole workspace (team), optionally scoped to spaces/folders/lists. ClickUp's "Get Filtered Team Tasks". ClickUp REST: GET /team/{team_id}/task.

statuses.description: Filter by status names (repeated statuses[] params), e.g. ["open","in progress"].

assignees.description: Filter by assignee user ids (repeated assignees[] params).

space_ids.description: Restrict to these space ids (repeated space_ids[] params).

project_ids.description: Restrict to these folder/project ids (repeated project_ids[] params).

list_ids.description: Restrict to these list ids (repeated list_ids[] params).

due_date_gt.description: Only tasks due after this Unix time in ms.

due_date_lt.description: Only tasks due before this Unix time in ms.

tools.name: clickup_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create a new task in a list. `name` is required; the list is the {list_id} path param, not a body field. ClickUp REST: POST /list/{list_id}/task.

list_id.description: The list id to create the task in (path param, not body).

assignees.description: User ids to assign the task to (numeric).

status.description: Status name (must be a valid status in the list).

due_date.description: Due date as Unix time in ms.

due_date_time.description: Whether due_date carries a time component (else date-only).

start_date.description: Start date as Unix time in ms.

parent.description: Parent task id — set to create this task as a subtask.

tools.name: clickup_update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: WRITE: update fields on an existing task. Only the fields you pass are changed. ClickUp REST: PUT /task/{task_id}.

task_id.description: The task id to update (path param, not body).

status.description: New status name (must be valid for the list).

due_date.description: Due date as Unix time in ms.

due_date_time.description: Whether due_date carries a time component (else date-only).

start_date.description: Start date as Unix time in ms.

parent.description: Parent task id (re-parent as a subtask).

tools.name: clickup_create_task_comment
tools.title: Create task comment
tools.description: WRITE: add a comment to a task. `comment_text` is required; the task is the {task_id} path param. ClickUp REST: POST /task/{task_id}/comment.

task_id.description: The task id to comment on (path param, not body).

assignee.description: User id to assign the comment to (numeric).

notify_all.description: If true, notify everyone tagged/subscribed (else just the assignee).
